ns2:section.sectionText: Meets 2nd and 3rd weeks of SS1: Monday-Saturday, May 23-28 and Tuesday-Friday, May 31-June 3. Meets in Room 346Library (Rare Book and Manuscript Library) except for Sat., May 28, when it meets in Room 131 LISB. Elective course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections (see http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/programs/mbms/certificate1); permission of Marianne Steadley is required to enroll (steadley@illinois.edu). See section description at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog
